title: Non-Invasive Ventilation versus High Flow Oxygenotherapy in Patients at High Risk of Extubation Failure
official: Non-Invasive Ventilation versus High Flow Oxygenotherapy in Patients at High Risk of Extubation Failure
summary: Main objective: The primary objective will be the reduction of extubation failure.

interventions.name: Oxígeno Medicinal Líquido Air Liquide 99,5% v/v, gas criogénico medicinal en recipientes fijos.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 65 years
2. Hypercapnia (paCO2 > 45 mmHg) at the time of extubation
3. Ineffective cough
4. Abundant secretions
5. Body mass index (BMI)>30
6. Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) or asthma as a cause of invasive mechanical ventilation
7. Cardiac failure as a cause of intubation or history of ejection fraction <= 30%
8. Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation (APACHE II) > 12 at the time of extubation
9. Time of mechanical ventilation > 7 days
10. Positive water balance
11. Difficult or prolonged weaning
12. Pneumonia (or any medical pathology over surgical) as a cause of ARF
Exclusion criteria:
1. Structural neurologic disease
2. Direct extubation without performing a spontaneous breathing trial
3. Contraindication to apply NIV or high flow oxygen
4. Not intubation order
5. Life support therapy limitation
6. Tracheotomized
7. Spinal cord injury
8. Scheduled surgical intervention in the next 48 hours post-extubation
9. Re-admission
10. Transfer to another center
11. Refusal of the patient or relatives
